newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market firm, thin test-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market firm, thin test-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were firm in a light test on a live basis, compared with Friday's close, USDA said. Demand was light to moderate.
